header: The ask on one side, the thing being asked about on the other
lead: A call to action in two halves, with the picture on whichever side the editor chose.
bodytext:
Copy, rich text, one button, one quieter link and the small print share the left half; a single image takes the right. The toggle swaps the halves in the grid only — the copy stays first in the source, so a screen reader gets the ask before the picture either way.

Below the tablet breakpoint the two halves become one column and the media drops under the copy at its own proportions.
caption: The caption belongs to the picture and sits inside the figure.
note: The note is the small print under the actions.
